case_level_notes: Case appears largely compliant on its face, but several disclosure and furnisher-investigation specifics are absent from the narrative, warranting undetermined outcomes rather than affirmative compliance findings.

material_facts.fact: Account and month identified; ledger supplied

determinations.rationale: Consumer identified account, disputed field (30-day late notation), supplied basis with a servicer payment ledger, and CRA received notice directly.
Valid trigger present and no frivolous termination invoked.
Reinvestigation completed in 24 calendar days, within the 30-day window.

material_facts.fact: Furnisher notified on third business day with document image

determinations.rationale: CRA sent the dispute and document image to the furnisher on the third business day, within the 5-business-day window, and included relevant consumer information.

material_facts.fact: CRA reviewed ledger against furnisher payment history

determinations.rationale: CRA reviewed consumer ledger against furnisher payment history, not relying solely on automated coding.

material_facts.fact: Furnisher verified late payment; item recorded as verified

determinations.rationale: Item was verified after reasonable reinvestigation; no defect found, so item may remain.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Cannot confirm all required disclosure elements from narrative.

material_facts.fact: Results with revised report mailed 4 business days after completion
No mention of required disclosures in results notice

determinations.rationale: Results were mailed within 4 business days with revised report, but the packet does not state whether required disclosures (procedure description right, furnisher contact, consumer statement right, deletion notification right) were included.

material_facts.fact: CRA completed reinvestigation rather than terminating

determinations.rationale: No frivolous or irrelevant termination was invoked; the CRA performed a full reinvestigation.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Not applicable status follows from explicit facts.
determinations.rationale: No deletion occurred, so reinsertion safeguards are not applicable.

material_facts.fact: Dispute received directly by CRA on March 1

determinations.rationale: Dispute was received directly by the CRA; no reseller involved.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Verification alone does not establish full s-2(b) compliance.

material_facts.fact: Furnisher response verifying the late payment
No details on furnisher's internal investigation scope or cross-CRA reporting

determinations.rationale: Furnisher provided a verifying response, but the packet does not state whether the furnisher reviewed all relevant information (e.g., the consumer ledger image) or reported to other nationwide CRAs as required.

material_facts.fact: Dispute received by CRA, not direct to furnisher

determinations.rationale: No direct furnisher dispute is described; only an indirect CRA-routed dispute occurred.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Absence from narrative is not proof of compliance.

material_facts.fact: Item verified; dispute not resolved for consumer
No mention of consumer statement option or filing

determinations.rationale: Reinvestigation did not resolve the dispute in the consumer's favor (item verified). Packet does not say whether the consumer filed a brief statement or whether the right to add one was disclosed.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Routing triggers not present in narrative.

material_facts.fact: No conflicts, identity theft, or special-process triggers in packet

determinations.rationale: No identity theft, mixed file, court order, veteran medical debt, material date conflict, or missing primary documents are indicated. Documents were considered and compared.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Cannot certify overall compliance without confirming all sub-elements.

material_facts.fact: Multiple sub-determinations undetermined due to missing details

determinations.rationale: Core trigger, timing, furnisher notice, consideration, and item treatment appear satisfied, but results-notice disclosure elements, furnisher s-2(b) scope details, and consumer-statement handling are not established by the packet.
